## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON, with broad strength. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation comes from broad sector participation and XLY/XLP expansion ↑ rising (1W: +0.87% | 1M: -1.51%), RECOVERY; VXX (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +1.40%) is ABOVE TREND, a counter-signal of rising fear.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress is easing short term: HYG/LQD (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.77%) ↑ rising on the week, RECOVERY, despite a weaker month. Fear is increasing: VXX (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +1.40%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND; SPY/TLT (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +0.56%) ↓ falling on the week, CORRECTION.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Mixed: UUP (1W: -0.69% | 1M: +1.54%) ↓ falling on the week, CORRECTION. Yield-curve ratio (1W: +0.34% | 1M: -0.38%) ↑ rising on the week, RECOVERY; duration-preference ratio (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -0.26%) ↑ rising on the week, RECOVERY.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals and defensives both advanced: XLY (1W: +3.61% | 1M: +2.85%) and XLP (1W: +1.22% | 1M: +5.29%) are ABOVE TREND; XLE (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +10.33%) is ABOVE TREND. XLK (1W: -0.99% | 1M: -3.94%) is BELOW TREND; Tech/Financials ratio (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -6.06%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND, with breadth supporting Value/Cyclicals over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US equities are steadier: SPY (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -0.04%) is in RECOVERY. Global lag persists: EEM (1W: -1.27% | 1M: -8.00%) and FXI (1W: -2.72% | 1M: -5.89%) are BELOW TREND; EM/US ratio (1W: -0.78% | 1M: -6.76%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative assets show a short-term bounce, not a confirmed recovery: IWM (1W: +1.88% | 1M: -3.74%), ARKK (1W: +1.11% | 1M: -6.76%), and IBIT (1W: +3.46% | 1M: -2.03%) are all in RECOVERY. Speculation-index ratio (1W: -0.48% | 1M: -5.50%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Energy leads: BNO (1W: +3.06% | 1M: +15.78%) and PDBC (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +3.20%) are ABOVE TREND. Metals remain weak on the month: GLD (1W: +0.79% | 1M: -5.28%) and SLV (1W: +4.06% | 1M: -13.95%) are in RECOVERY; CPER (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -4.56%) is BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy strength is confirmed: XLE (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +10.33%) and BNO (1W: +3.06% | 1M: +15.78%) are ABOVE TREND. Natural gas remains weak: UNG (1W: -11.14% | 1M: -8.20%) is BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: XLE (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +10.33%) is ABOVE TREND, while XLK (1W: -0.99% | 1M: -3.94%) is BELOW TREND. MAJOR divergence across core assets: SPY (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -0.04%) and TLT (1W: +1.71% | 1M: -1.45%) are in RECOVERY, while XLK is BELOW TREND; treat the broad regime as transitional despite the data’s RISK-ON label.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor broad participation and energy strength, while monitoring tech weakness; reduce exposure to persistent laggards rather than treating the risk signal as uniform. Style tilts toward Value/Cyclicals over Growth, with bonds mixed: TLT (1W: +1.71% | 1M: -1.45%) is in RECOVERY.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If breadth holds near 10/11 and cyclicals remain firm, monitor XLY (1W: +3.61% | 1M: +2.85%), ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: If tech weakness extends, monitor XLK (1W: -0.99% | 1M: -3.94%), BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If energy momentum persists, monitor BNO (1W: +3.06% | 1M: +15.78%), ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: If industrial demand remains soft, monitor CPER (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -4.56%), BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Monitor HYG/LQD at 0.7459 (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.77%), ↑ rising on the week, RECOVERY; SPY/TLT at 9.6347 (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +0.56%), ↓ falling on the week, CORRECTION. Also watch the Tech/Financials ratio at 3.3644 (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -6.06%), ↓ falling, BELOW TREND, and VXX (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +1.40%), ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, with broad strength; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Energy and cyclicals show relative strength, favoring Value/Cyclicals over Growth. Rising VXX and weak tech momentum remain key divergences to monitor.
